resources.string: HealthBridge reads existing records to deduplicate and writes only NEW workouts, steps, heart rate, sleep, active energy, resting heart rate, and VO2 max to Health Connect. Everything is processed on-device. No data ever leaves your phone.
HealthBridge is fully offline. There is no network access, no account, and no backend. Your Apple Health export is parsed in local cache and deleted immediately after processing.
